name: Blueprint Constructivist
note: The engineer's notebook (see docs/design-system.md style 2): cool blue-gray paper tinted at hue 250, drafting-blue accent, IBM Plex Mono in every slot — monospace IS the identity. Sharp corners, flat shadows, hairline borders, faint grain like graph paper. Manhattan geometry in layout: 90-degree turns only. Don't introduce a proportional font and don't warm the neutrals.
